title: Micah's prophecy about the ruler from Bethlehem
description: The prophet Micah proclaims that from the small town of Bethlehem Ephrata will come a ruler over Israel, one whose origins are from ancient times, from days of eternity, and who will shepherd his people in the Lord's strength like a shepherd.
